title: Playful Toddler & Kids on WPA Stone Fountain, 1930s Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot from the New Deal era capturing children playing on a multi-tiered rustic stone fountain or park monument. In the foreground, a young child in overalls sits on the stone ledge covering their face playfully. Below the child, set into the stonework, is an official Works Progress Administration (WPA) bronze plaque, grounding the scene in 1930s Great Depression-era civic infrastructure and public works development.
